title: Joe's Slow Cooker Pulled Pork (Instant Pot slow cook)
description: Joe's own pulled pork: bone-in pork butt with a Yellowstone/Weber rub, candied jalapenos, and El Yucateco XXXtra Hot, slow cooked at 212F for 8 hours in his 8-quart Emeril Lagasse Instant Pot.

ingredients.note: a little over 1/3 cup Yellowstone Rancher's All Purpose, the rest Weber Original Dry Rub

steps: Coat the pork with the rub and jalapenos and set it in the pot. No added liquid.
Put the non-vented glass lid on. Set slow cook mode to 212F for 8 hours. The timer starts once the pot reaches 212F.
At the 2-hour mark, pour the 1 tbsp El Yucateco XXXtra Hot over the top of the meat.
When the 8 hours are up, shred, pull the bone, and toss the pork with some of the pot juices.
source: Joe (his own recipe, sent via Thrifty; saved by Meal Plan; corrected by Head Chef)
notes: Equipment: Joe's 8-quart Emeril Lagasse Instant Pot, slow cook mode. Corrected Oct 23, 2026 after the original 8-hour cook was not done. Cook note: the meat makes its own juice, about halfway up the butt by the end. Oct 23, 2026 result: delicious. Mild heat that only very sensitive people would call spicy. Full, sweet, deep pork flavor with a bite at the end. Well rounded, the flavors blend together instead of standing out on their own. Keep the seasoning as is. Packed in quart zipper bags with all the juice.

healthy: Pork butt gives a lot of protein.
Cooked with no added oil or liquid.
not_healthy: Pork butt is a fatty cut, high in saturated fat.
A full cup of rub adds a lot of sodium.
